name: @pipeworx/mcp-findymail

tools.name: findymail_find_email
tools.description: Find the work email for a person by name + company domain — give a person's full name and their company domain and get their verified business email (with job title and LinkedIn when available). B2B prospecting / outreach. Example: findymail_find_email({ name: "Patrick Collison", domain: "stripe.com", _apiKey: "your-findymail-key" })

name.description: Full name of the person, e.g. "Patrick Collison"

_apiKey.description: Your Findymail API key (get one at findymail.com)

tools.name: findymail_reverse_email
tools.description: Look up the person/LinkedIn profile behind an email address — give an email and get the person's name, company, job title, and LinkedIn URL when available. Reverse-email enrichment. Example: findymail_reverse_email({ email: "patrick@stripe.com", _apiKey: "your-findymail-key" })

email.description: Email address to look up, e.g. "patrick@stripe.com"

_apiKey.description: Your Findymail API key (get one at findymail.com)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-findymail forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the findymail pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
